name: Doxycycline
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.dose: 200 mg on day 1 (100 mg every 12 hours), then 100 mg daily

usual_adult_dose.indication: More severe infections (for example chronic urinary tract infection)

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Antacids containing aluminum, calcium or magnesium; bismuth subsalicylate; iron preparations
key_interactions.action: Do not take at the same time; the label gives no spacing interval.

key_interactions.effect: Tetracyclines can depress plasma prothrombin activity (label 7.1).
key_interactions.action: The anticoagulant dose may need to be lowered; monitor INR.

key_interactions.effect: Bacteriostatic drugs may interfere with the bactericidal action of penicillin (label 7.2).
key_interactions.action: Avoid the combination (label: advisable to avoid).
Expect lower doxycycline levels; monitor response.

serious: Permanent tooth discoloration in children under 8

pk.peak: About 3.6 mcg/mL at about 2.6 hours after 200 mg
pk.excretion_renal_pct: About 40% in urine over 72 hours with normal function; 1% to 5% at CrCl below 10

draft_notes: Pinned label (Wellhouse, NDA050641) has no captured interaction section; interactions are from the DORYX label section 7 (NDA050795), read via DailyMed and the FDA label PDF (Drugs@FDA, 050795s037lbl.pdf, revised 3/2025). Methoxyflurane is not in that label and was not added.

revision_log.change: Interactions added from a US doxycycline label section 7 (DORYX, NDA050795): antacids (Al/Ca/Mg), bismuth subsalicylate and iron (absorption); anticoagulants; penicillin; barbiturates/carbamazepine/phenytoin; oral contraceptives. Methoxyflurane not added (not in the label obtained).
